triage#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZKP5YM48rWMWTS7wE

Triage: lands in `area:data` · `domain:server` · `priority:p2` · Bug · `pm:queue` · size S; area and grade added (the card carried neither); type set to Bug.
Rationale: a compare-to-previous-period bucket that cannot be aligned keeps its own key and can overwrite the current window's first bucket, so a dashboard shows a wrong comparison with no error. Aggregates and dashboards adding up is `area:data` core feature ③. Under North Star Priority rule 2 a value computed and shown wrongly (nothing stored is wrong) is Impeded; reach is end users reading compare widgets on a time axis ⇒ p2. Fix and pins stay in `service-analytics`, as the card proposes.
